Coping these files to disable check for update settings and help improvement program.
We are copying these files but not removing in post uninstall because these files are generating in runtime
File under %Userprofile% is deleted becuase during repair the "Visual Profiler" shortcut was not behaving as expected.
This folder is created in runtime, so we are keeping empty check.
